_: The relay operator's denylist refusing a NETWORK address (t14-deny + t14-deny-client), on a THROWAWAY test relay.

show the refused-network dialog within seconds while a, on another machine, stays connected. Try again is
refused again while listed; once lifted, Try again connects.
